entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-20
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Identity value generation can only be used with signed integer properties. #7250
  • The entity type 'Uri' requires a primary key to be defined (EF Core 1.1) #7133
  • Model building: Cycles not detected properly #7039
  • Data Annotations seems doesn't work in derived class #7007
  • No executable found matching command "dotnet-ef" #6931
  • SQL Server: Set nullable unique index filter using convention #6901
  • Consider adding more services to IDatabaseProviderServices or IRelationalDatabaseProviderServices #6705
  • TPH: Support more discriminator conditions (NotNull etc.) #4722
  • Support partial entity materialization #2849
  • ComplexType.get_ConstructorBinding throws InvalidCastException trying to cast to IReadOnlyEntityType #32437
    10.0.0
  • EF Core logs error (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Connection.ConnectionError) when cancelling an operation on Sql Server #36235
  • Ef Core 9 / CosmosDb Provider with Embedded Collections - Shadow Id Property error on update #36217
  • Temporal table using TemporalAsOf()- Get the temporal data of the related/child entities as well ? #36236
  • Entity framework produces libSystem.native error #36258

Updated

  • Support partial loading (i.e. not eagerly loading all scalar properties) #1387
    Backlog
  • NAOT; error when trying to run precompile queries step - "The build host could not be found" #36055
    Backlog
  • By convention we generate ambiguous table name for some models with owned collections #35710
    10.0.0
  • Throw on RelationalEventId.MigrationsNotFound by default #35218
    Backlog
  • Throw an exception when generating compiled model code that attempts to reference private methods #35033
    Backlog
  • AOT : when precompiled model is not nativeaot compatible, we should throw an informative exception telling users to use -nativeaot switch #35006
    Backlog
  • Complex type observable ordered value type collection support #31411
    Backlog
  • Allow HasConversion/ValueConverters to convert nulls #13850
    Backlog
  • Complex type collection support #31237
    10.0.0
  • Support by-convention OnAdd for value-converted keys #35919
    Backlog
  • Cosmos: project anonymous type with collection throws type mismatch in CosmosProjectionBindingExpressionVisitor #35702
    Backlog
  • Cosmos/FTS: Fuzzy search #36204
    10.0.0
  • Allow mapping optional complex properties #31376
    10.0.0
  • Primitive collections EF10 checklist #36101
    10.0.0
  • Avoid checked-in nuspec files #36254
  • Improvements to relational database mappings #22953
    Backlog
  • Allow Entity Splitting with non-identifying FKs #36251
    Backlog
  • SQL Server migrations should use QUOTENAME when constructing SQL for EXEC #36264
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix overflow in Cosmos tests #36275
  • [release/10.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36274
  • SQL Server migrations should use QUOTENAME when constructing SQL for EXEC #36271
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36272
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36270

Updated

  • Add change tracking support for complex collections #35962
  • Update buildtools container. #36228
  • Tiny fixup to #36232 #36268
  • Handle primitive collections as multiple parameters. #36157
